pmr_dam_columbia_river_on_level = {
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 9  NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_complete } }
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_complete
	}
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 1  NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_fx_1 } }
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_fx_1
		s:STATE_WASHINGTON = {
				add_arable_land = 15
			}
	}
}

		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_guatape_falls_complete
	}
}

pmr_dam_first_cataract_on_level = {
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 1  NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_complete } }
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_complete
	}
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 1  NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fx_1 } }
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fx_1
		s:STATE_MIDDLE_EGYPT = {
				remove_state_trait = state_trait_pmr_basin_irrigation
				add_arable_land = 8
			}
	}
}
